Following documents (as applicable) must be submitted along with the bid – (a) Details related to ownership of minimum 04 vehicles (Sedan or higher segment i.e. except hatchback) having year of vehicle model 2024, 2025 or 2026. These details are to be filled in the Annexure-2 attache d with the bid under “Buyer uploaded ATC document” and submitted along with the bid. Non submission of Annexure-2 will lead to rejection of offer.

(These vehicles should be registered in firm’s name or in the name of the proprietor / partner of the firm. Copy of registration certificate as proof of ownership should be uploaded by the bi dder.) Please do not quote any rate for Extra Km or Extra Hrs by attaching any sheet as rates mentio ned in GeM SLA will only be applicable for extra Km and extra Hrs.
